notes.title: Tri Survive Launch Update: Endless Mode Fixes on the Way!
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors!

Tri Survive is finally out! Our very first game release, a huge milestone for us at Majestic Mind Games. But as much as we’d love to take a moment to celebrate, we’re already hard at work on the next updates.

One of the first things on our radar is the Endless Mode, those of you who have completed all levels and started testing your true survivability skills in the Endless Mode may have noticed some issues we want to address right away:



- Performance drops, If you survive for long enough, the enemy hordes get too crazy, making things choppy if you’re not clearing them fast enough.

- Level cap stuck at 50, after this point, no more stat bonuses (attack speed, damage, etc) are applied to the heroes. And no more special cards appear on leveling up (Heal, Triangle Ability Re-charge, Riches).

-  EXP/Gold overflow, past level 51, orbs and gold pile up under your heroes and don't actually get collected.



We want you to know we’re on top of this. We’re working on improving the Endless Mode design, optimizing performance during those hectic late game runs, and raising the level cap so you can keep pushing your limits!


Our goal is to have the first patch out next week.



Thank you all so much for jumping in, sharing your feedback, and being part of this launch journey with us. And we look forward to enhancing and refining Tri Survive with you.


 Stay strong, and tri to survive! ♥



– The MMG Team

notes.title: Tri Survive Demo Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors!

In preparation for the full release this month, we are also releasing a quick update to the demo.


Update notes:


Overhaul of the manual ability triggering system, making it easier and more fun to play with manual ability triggering.

Improved controller support.

Updated tutorial. 

Visual and UI improvements

Added 13 languages for localization. 

Some audio improvements.

Added credits section and credits button to Main Menu.

Some balancing to the characters and levels making them a bit smoother and easier but still challenging. 

Updates to the Power Up Shop.



Thank you everyone, for the feedback and support you've shown us so far! Follow our socials and join our Discord Server to be the first to know about the latest Tri Survive news!

notes.title: Tri Survive Demo Update 1.5.4 Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors!

We listened to your feedback and put in the work to refine Tri Survive Demo further, thanks to the Update 1.5.4!


Here's the update notes:


Added new Main Menu music.

Added new level 1 music.

Added new level 2 music.

Visual improvements to the hero characters, making them less pixelated during gameplay.

Visual improvements to the UI and button selection to make it clearer for controller users which button they are hovering over and selecting. (still needs further work).

Added controller support for some UI sections that previously did not have it.

Added a tutorial section to explain that you can toggle between automatically or manually triggering your heroes’ abilities (using T on keyboard, or B on Xbox controller).

Replaced some placeholder UI sections with better visuals.

Fixed a bug causing Hawk Beast's death animation to keep playing after death.



Thank you, everyone, for the feedback and support you've shown us so far! Follow our socials and join our Discord Server to be the first to know about the latest Tri Survive news!
